= Tenant

Wraps another cache to add in separation by tenant. This is useful for a multi-tenant deployment where a custom provider varies its output per tenant (e.g. different imagery or authorization per organization).

The tenant ID is populated by xref:configuration/authentication/index.adoc[authentication]. A request with no tenant ID falls back to the same cache key it would use without this wrapper, making this utterly pointless for a single-tenant (or unauthenticated) deployment.

Do note that tenant ID will be subject to the same sanitization as layer names. That is, non-alphanumeric characters will be replaced with an underscore in some cases. If your tenant IDs differ by only special characters, rethink your tenant IDs. 

Name should be "tenant"

Configuration options:

[cols="1,3,1,1,1"]
|===
| Parameter | Description | Type | Required | Default

| cache
| The wrapped Cache configuration
| Cache
| Yes
| None
|===

Example:

[,yaml]
----
cache:
  name: tenant
  cache:
    name: disk
    path: "./disk_tile_cache"
----
